_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the DRIP hierarchy, Python side.
PUBLIC DATA ONLY - never put a private seed in this file.
The firmware's counterpart is drip_hierarchy.h. After editing EITHER, run:
which re-derives every DET from scratch, proves the zones nest per
RFC 9886 section 6, and proves this file and the header still agree.
TEST VALUES: no IANA registration stands behind them (RFC 9374 section 3.3).

apex._role: trust anchor. Replaces observer.py's hardcoded APEX_HI/APEX_DET. Under RFC 9886 section 7.1 this is what DNSSEC would anchor.

raa._role: Registered Assigning Authority. RAA number must equal ua_raa; hda is 0 (an RAA hands out HDA numbers, it has none).

hda._role: HHIT Domain Authority - registers the UAs. Must carry BOTH ua_raa and ua_hda or its /56 zone will not contain them.
